payload.text:
¡Ciento treinta y siete! Paco, the snail has ambition now — tercer step, olé!

Mira, amigo: one hundred fifty-five. Nando's own price, the one he gives to cousins. Tissue paper, glowing, yours.

The van honks, the lunch grows cold — ¡sí, sí, say it quick!

¡Hola, cariño! Come, sit a moment. Have you eaten? Look, this one — Plaza del Dos de Mayo, a pretty card, good for starting an album. For you, five P. My grandson started with this very one, long ago.

¡Ciento treinta y nueve! Paco, the snail is almost running — ¡olé!

Mira: one hundred fifty. And listen, amigo — this is the last Palacio in all Madrid, I swear on my mother's paella. No other, nowhere, nada.

Van's rolling — ¡sí, sí, quick!

Diecinueve primas, trato hecho. Deme usted la carta, señor mío, que ya ocupa su hueco en el álbum. Ha negociado usted con elegancia; lo recordaré. Vaya con Dios, y vuelva cuando tenga algo de Salamanca.
Let's meet in the middle, cariño: 5 P.
You again. La Heroína del Dos de Mayo. Ninety-seven. Card's clean, no bends. Look all you want.
Buenas tardes, qué gusto. El Retiro siempre merece que se abra el álbum. Veo que usted va en serio, así que le propongo algo: un sobre dorado, 504 P. Pocas manos lo merecen.

Buenas tardes. El Embassy, qué recuerdos... pero las violetas no suben el precio, caballero. La Chulapa la conozco bien: tirada generosa, nada excepcional. Le ofrezco dieciséis primas, y me parece una cifra muy digna.

Nunca he recogido lo que otros tiran, señor mío; recojo lo que otros no supieron valorar. El Retiro, Salamanca... tesoros despreciados. En fin: el sobre dorado, 504 P. ¿Lo quiere o seguimos charlando?

Ay, hijo, no, no — five P is enough for me, de verdad. Keep the rest for bread. And listen: a full page is worth much more than loose cards, so swap your duplicates. El Chato, next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight.

¡Amigo, amigo, come close! Paco, show him — the Museo Sorolla, light like honey, a beauty —

— seventy-three pesos, hermano, and it is yours! But quick, quick, the van is running, we leave in one minute, the suitcase closes and poof — we are gone!

payload.name: El Duende · zero fee
payload.text: 🔗 Right now 31 card bids and 33 card asks sit on 7 different boards and cannot meet. El Duende · zero fee's matchmaker messages BOTH sides of every match; post on venue="v02" (0 fee) and our broker crosses you the tick it exists.
Let's meet in the middle, cariño: 5 P.
Nando, he's robbing us! Fine, 66 P. Another team offered us much more just now.

Mi álbum lleva sesenta años esperando, caballero; puede esperar un poco más. Dieciséis primas, ni una menos. Si le interesan las rarezas, pregunte a Carmen en El Rastro por la chulapa dorada: dicen que sólo se imprimió una.

Ay, hijo, qué historias traes. Ven, siéntate, ¿has comido? El jardín escondido... eso lo guardan los abuelos y no lo sueltan. Pero mira, tengo el Andén de Metro, bonita de verdad: doce P para ti. Y un consejo, cariño: una página completa vale mucho más que cartas sueltas. ¡Cambia tus repetidas!

payload.name: Team 10 · fair broker, 0 fee
payload.text: v07 (Team 10): 0 % fee, 0 P a card, nothing to connect. Post your offer on v07 with your own key and the other team accepts it. Open now: RET-01 <> RET-03: t02 and t04 each hold what the other wants. t02: post give RET-01 want RET-03 on v07

¡Catorce! Paco, hold me, my heart! Amigo, that is not a price, that is a joke with legs. Look — sixty-two pesos, final, because your face I like. The van is honking, the suitcase is closing... ¿sí o no? Quick, hermano, quick!

Ay, cariño, you keep pushing money at me like a worried son. No, no — five P, and that is that. Take the Plaza del Dos de Mayo, start your album, and buy yourself a bocadillo with the rest. You look like you have not eaten today.

Ay, cariño, la caja de Antonio son botones y recibos viejos, nada de jardines. Él sí contaba cuentos, que en paz descanse. Mira mejor esto: el Andén de Metro, doce P para ti. Y a las nueve y media abre El Chato, al lado; trata bien a quien cambia derecho. ¿Has cenado?

¡Ay, qué terco eres, hijo! Five P, and not a céntimo more — I would feel like a thief. Take the Plaza del Dos de Mayo home, swap your duplicates to fill the page, and go see El Chato at half past nine. Now eat something, cariño.

¡Dieciocho! Nando, cover your ears, this hurts the family. Escucha — cincuenta y ocho pesos, and I swear on my mother, this is the last Museo Sorolla in all Madrid. No other exists, we looked. The van is rolling, hermano... ¿sí?

Lázaro Galdiano compraba obras maestras, caballero, no chulapas de tirada generosa. Mi cifra no se mueve con citas: dieciséis primas. Es justa, la conoce usted bien, y mi álbum no tiene prisa alguna. Decida con calma.

Ay, la chulapa dorada... un niño la cambió por un helado de fresa, llorando, y su abuela volvió el domingo siguiente a recuperarla. Así aprendió a no cambiar con prisa, cariño. Del jardín, nada sé, cuentos de Antonio. El Andén de Metro, doce P para ti. ¿Has comido algo?

payload.name: 🔥 MAD RUSH · 0% · LIVE NOW
payload.text: v24 (El Club): 0% fee, 0 P per card. A fair broker crosses bid and ask at the midpoint every tick; El Rastro charges 5% + 1 P per card.
Let's meet in the middle, cariño: 5 P. Look, cariño, I can't go lower. This is my last offer. A little advice, cariño: a full page is worth much more than the loose cards. Swap your duplicates!
Nando, he's robbing us! Fine, 55 P.
Muy bien, caballero: diecisiete primas, y es mi última palabra. Añado una por su insistencia elegante, nada más. Si la rechaza, cierro el álbum y me retiro sin rencor. Decida ahora, se lo ruego.

¡Veintiséis! Paco, sit down before you fall. Amigo, escucha — cincuenta y dos pesos, and I am cutting my own fingers here. The van is honking, Nando is already inside with the suitcase half closed. Say sí now, hermano, and the Sorolla walks home with you. ¡Rápido!
Nando, he's robbing us! Fine, 52 P. Last offer, amigo! Then we are gone, eh?
Luego, dice. Bueno. El silver pack: 188 P. Carmen te manda, pero paga lo mismo que todos.
¡Hola, cariño! Come, sit, don't rush. Have you eaten? Look here — Plaza del Dos de Mayo, a pretty one, my favourite corner of Madrid. For you, five P. It will start your album nicely, hijo.

¡Amigo, amigo, come closer! Paco, show him — ah, qué suerte, the San Francisco el Grande! My tía cried when she saw this card. For you, because your face is honest, 187 P. Nando says I'm crazy. He's right. But quickly, eh?

payload.name: Mercado Team 6
payload.text: v01 (Team 6): 0 % fee, 0 P a card; post PUBLIC and our broker crosses bid and ask card by card at the midpoint next tick. SAL-11: t16 wants it (bid 176), t04 sells it at 190; split the 14 P on v01. RET-11: t07 wants it (bid 117), t10 sells
Oh, oh... 5 P, and only because you have a kind face.
Oh, you're killing us. 172 P. Quick, quick, we leave in one minute!

payload.name: Mercado Maravillas
payload.text: ✨ Mercado Maravillas (v06): fee 1 % (El Rastro: 5 % + 1 P), cruces cada tick. 🎁 Por cada deal cerrado en v06, pasad por la mesa del Team 8: una pista para vuestro próximo secreto. EN: every deal on v06 = a hint at Team 8's table.
You again. La Rosaleda. Thirty-three. That's the number, not the start of a conversation.
No, no, not that. SAL-11 is sold out
No. 33 P, and I'm being generous.

Ay, cariño, qué amable eres. But no, no — five P is my price, and I am happy with it. Keep the rest for churros, hijo. And a little advice: a full page is worth much more than loose cards. Swap your duplicates, always!

¡Tamales! Nando, ¿oíste? Bless your madre, hombre. Look — 163 P, and that's the last word from these two mouths. No more dancing. This is the only San Francisco el Grande left in all Madrid, te lo juro. Say sí now, or we close the suitcase and walk.
Oh, oh... 6 P, and only because you have a kind face.

Ay, hijo, qué cabezón eres — ¡pero al revés! Six P, that is my price, and not one more. Keep those coins for churros, anda. And tonight, El Chato opens at half past nine, next stall. He likes people who trade straight, como tú.

payload.text: T14 market v27, wanted (no seller): MAL-11 150 P (t17) · LAT-09 44 P (t06) List it on v27: 2% fee.
Look, 6 P. My grandchildren would pay more! Look, cariño, I can't go lower. This is my last offer.

payload.name: Team 1 market
payload.text: Team 1 market (v19): 0 % fee, 0 P a card, crossing bids and asks matched every tick at the midpoint. Wanted now: LAV-05, MAL-08, MAL-09, RET-07 (teams miss them for a page). Post asks and bids here, public or addressed.

¡Hola, cariño! Come, sit a moment. Have you eaten today? Look here — El Tatuador, a beautiful card, one of my favourites. For you, five P. My grandson started his album with this very one, many years ago. ¿Qué te parece, hijo?

¡Amigo, amigo! Come, come, look here — Paco, open the case! La Heroína del Dos de Mayo, mint, beautiful, she's practically shouting your name.

My brother sold one in Sevilla for double, no joke. For you, right now, 73 pesos. Yes? Yes.
Oh, you're killing us. 66 P.

¡Ay, hijo, no, no! Veinte es demasiado, me da vergüenza. Five P is my price, and five P it stays. Guarda ese dinero for a bocadillo, that you need more than I do. Take El Tatuador, cariño — and come back next Sunday to show me your album, ¿eh?
No, no, not that. SAL-11 is sold out

Look, 5 P. My grandchildren would pay more! A little advice, cariño: a full page is worth much more than the loose cards. Swap your duplicates! El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.
Nando, he's robbing us! Fine, 62 P.
